blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Diocese of Imus has called on parishes to organize activities that promote youth participation in the Catholic Church as it prepares to observe Local World Youth Day, Youth Ministry Awareness Week, and National Youth Day from November 22 to 29.
